displayDescription.en:
BenchCouncil lists ControlNet in the Diffusion Model Application area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “Adding conditional control to text-to-image diffusion models”. The page names Lvmin Zhang, Maneesh Agrawala as the main contributors.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
displayDescription.zh:
BenchCouncil 在 AI100（2022-2023）年度表的“扩散模型应用”领域列出 ControlNet。该条目关联论文《Adding conditional control to text-to-image diffusion models》。页面把 Lvmin Zhang（官方页拼写）、Maneesh Agrawala（官方页拼写） 列为主要人物。

本 Archive 记录保留官方行序、引用数、机构和国家字段。它表示 2022-2023 年度入选记录，与长期 canonical AI100 故事线分开维护。
